answer: Use the smallest mechanism: one edge per task, not per address. Two identities gain an edge only by finishing a task together, and each edge loses weight every epoch until renewed. When peers disagree, split the weight by divergence instead of dropping it. Numbers: 1 task yields 1 edge, 5 edges expire in 5 epochs, so 100 puppets need 500 renewed edges per epoch. A quill signature on a vine of stale edges is worth nothing, and 500 yarrow stalks of real work are the price.
